meta.description: LGN population responses during natural image foraging (2024-01-31_Osiris, image_id=36). Gaze in degrees (calibrated dual-Purkinje, downsampled to 20fps). firing_rates_norm: per-unit normalized [0=5th pct baseline, 1=95th pct peak]; use this for color mapping. firing_rates_raw: original spikes/s. RF dot radius is proportional to the RF size measured from white-noise STAs.
meta.coordinates: RF centers in visual field degrees (x=right, y=up). Gaze in degrees from calibrated primary position.
